name: Jada
source:
Jada is the mother of Aaliyah and Jamal, she is married to Jerome. Their marriage is not happy, Jada and Jerome can hardly be in the same room without arguing. (This is mostly Jerome's doing as he is short-tempered and aggressive and goes out of his way to aggravate people.) According to one thing Jada says, she and Jerome have not had sex in more than ten years!

Jada is a former photo-model and, as her marriage is strained, she spends much of her day doing workouts or swimming in their pool. She is thus in great shape and very flexible (the protagonist stands and ogles her as she do her workout routine and she does splits and bends like a gymnast.)

She has always had a soft spot for the protagonist. (In fact, after Jerome destroyed the birthday cake Aaliyah had baked for MC's eighteenth birthday, Jada gave him a consolation gift in secret, his first ever blowjob!)

Jada is friends with Allison, they talk on the phone occasionally.
